channel.title: Alan's Architect Atlas
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Alan's Architect Atlas

item.title: Hands-On: Student Scholarship Calculator
item.description: A step-by-step build of an expression set from scratch. For the concepts (resources, step elements, versioning), see 02-expression-sets.

item.title: Expression Sets
item.description: The calculation engine of BRE. An expression set is a sequence of steps run in order, built in Expression Set Builder.

item.title: Decision Explainer
item.description: A service that records and surfaces why a business rule produced a specific result. Part of 01-business-rules-engine-overview.

item.title: Business Rules Engine (BRE) — Overview
item.description: Business Rules Engine is a shared Industries component (not specific to one cloud) for building eligibility, qualification, pricing and calculation logic outside of code.

item.title: Decision Matrices and Decision Tables
item.description: Together these are BRE lookup tables, usable as a 02-expression-sets Lookup Table step, directly in Flow, or via API.

item.title: BRE Integration and Operations
item.description: How to call BRE, run it at scale, and migrate to it. Part of 01-business-rules-engine-overview.

item.title: BRE Use Case: Benefit Eligibility
item.description: End-to-end walkthrough demonstrating decision matrix vs decision table, matrix types (standard vs grouped), expression set orchestration, versioning, and explainability.

item.title: Standard Object Oddities
item.description: See also Ownership/queue support by object, relationship limits, and delete behaviour: data-model-constraints-and-limits.

item.title: Action Plans — Overview
item.description: An action plan defines the tasks and items needed to complete a business process.

item.title: Actionable Relationship Center (ARC)
item.description: ARC lets users view customer or constituent relationships in an easy-to-navigate, interactive graph (ARC overview).
